Predicates:
Fly(x, y) ::: x flies to y.
Airport(y) ::: y is an airport.
Premises:
Susan flies to LGA airport. ::: Susan flies to LGA airport.
The departure and arrival can not be the same airport. ::: The departure and arrival airports are different. 
John flies from LGA airport. ::: John flies from LGA airport.
Conclusion:
Fly(John, LGA) ::: John flies to LGA airport.
